description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'PermissionController' responsible for handling HTTP requests related to user permissions management in the admin section of a web application. It includes endpoints for displaying permissions and paging permissions data, and references services for permissions, groups, countries, and utilities for AJAX responses and messaging.

classes.name: PermissionController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing permissions, including endpoints for displaying permissions interface and paging through permissions data.

methods.name: displayPermissions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the permissions page. Currently throws a 'Not implemented' exception.

methods.name: pagePermissions
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve a list of permissions in JSON format, populating AJAX response data.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private utility method to set menu attributes in the model, currently unused and commented out.
